official_source_observations.fact: -p sets dumpClient=true; default is false; top-resumed dispatches to ActivityTaskManager.
Client dump passes innerPrefix as an application argument and transfers client bytes without enforcing a TransferPipe buffer prefix at that call site.
top-resumed dumps only the current server ActivityRecord; no client dump is invoked in that branch. This is not a package filter.
Server dump emits windows=mChildren, allowing the verified parent Window identity to bind the top Activity record.
Upstream nonfullscreen Autofill uses APPLICATION_ABOVE_SUB_PANEL; fullscreen uses SYSTEM_DIALOG.
